'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
****Large numbers of fighting-age men leave [[Russia]] after the announcement of the [[mobilization]]. Long traffic jams occur at international border crossings and the price of tickets for international flights sharply increases. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62996212 (BBC News)]
****At least 1,300 protesters rallying against the mobilization are arrested throughout Russia. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-62981293 (BBC News)]
***[[Donetsk People's Republic]] authorities accuse [[Ukraine]] of [[shell (projectile)|shelling]] a market in [[Donetsk]], killing six [[civilian]]s. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/separatists-say-6-killed-by-ukraine-shelling-on-donetsk-market/ (''Times of Israel'')]
***Ukraine and Russia release 55 Russian [[prisoners of war]] and 215 fighters from the [[Siege of Mariupol]] as part of a [[prisoner exchange]] [[mediation|mediated]] by [[Turkey]] and [[Saudi Arabia]]. Among those released are pro-Russian Ukrainian politician [[Viktor Medvedchuk]], [[Azov Regiment]] commander [[Denys Prokopenko]], British volunteers [[Aiden Aslin]] and [[Shaun Pinner]], and Moroccan volunteer [[Brahim Saaudun|Saadun Brahim]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/russia-frees-215-mariupol-defenders-in-swap-for-putin-oligarch-ally-and-54-others/ (''Times of Israel'')], [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-62970683?pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:bb900c66-5abe-407d-bb6b-fdb36668c820 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 71 people are killed when a [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|boat carrying migrants]] from [[Lebanon]] [[capsize]]s off [[Syria]]'s coast. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/9/22/dozens-killed-as-migrant-boat-sinks-off-syria-state-media (Al Jazeera)]
*Two people are killed by a magnitude 6.9 [[list of earthquakes in Mexico|earthquake]] in [[Mexico City]]. The earthquake was an [[aftershock]] of the [[2022 Western Mexico earthquake|magnitude 7.6 earthquake]] that occurred three days ago in [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/sep/22/mexico-earthquake-michoacan (''The Guardian'')]
*At least three people are killed by an [[explosion]] at an [[oil refinery]] in [[Neuquén Province]], [[Argentina]]. [https://apnews.com/article/fires-caribbean-argentina-eaa14d6eabd79365c446d51bddcd8acd (AP)]
*Seven people are killed by [[landslide]]s in [[El Salvador]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-seven-dead-after-landslides-el-salvador-2022-09-22/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**Amid protests after the [[death of Mahsa Amini]], [[Iran]] restricts access to several websites, including [[Instagram]] and [[WhatsApp]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/iran-targeted-by-apparent-cyberattack-amid-protests/2022/09/21/e378b72e-39b3-11ed-b8af-0a04e5dc3db6_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-restricts-access-instagram-netblocks-2022-09-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Corruption in China]]
**[[China]]'s former justice minister [[Fu Zhenghua]] is [[sentence (law)|sentenced]] [[Death sentence with reprieve|to death with reprieve]], which means his sentence will be [[life in prison]] without the possibility of [[parole]], after pleading guilty to accepting [[bribes]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/chinas-former-justice-minister-jailed-for-life/a-63200185 (DW)]
